records.inherited_baseline: 隋末战乱后虽有大量既存典籍和旧类书传统，但唐初尚无《艺文类聚》这种把事类与文学材料并置、可供检索的新国家类书。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 写本时代可以编纂类书，但百卷级跨门类重新组织、完成并长期成为士人参考仍需国家组织。

records.durability_and_handoff: 长期流传并保存大量唐以前佚文，后世类书、诗文总集持续引用。

counterevidence.summary: 没有闭合武德朝广泛刊印或大众传播；主要仍属国家与士人参考，因此不进R3。

records.inherited_baseline: local medical teaching existed unevenly without the same quantified prefectural learner and touring-treatment duties
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: the mature Tang administrative network could sustain prefectural medical posts, while implementation still varied by locality
records.background_trend: earlier Tang medical institutions form the inherited baseline; only the Kaiyuan quantified expansion and realized service duties are consumed
records.attributable_change: 开元二十七年按州户数设置医生名额，令其在州境巡疗，并配套本草、验方和地方医学教学供给

records.inherited_baseline: early Tang inherited strong literary and scholarly capacity but lacked the same Jixian-centered compilation program, large geodetic survey, and completed Dayan-calendar chain
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: high-Tang fiscal, printing-manuscript, and scholarly conditions permitted major court projects but did not automatically produce their technical and textual outputs
records.background_trend: the wider high-Tang poetry and literary flourishing is recorded as a dynasty-curve result, not automatically assigned as personal credit
records.attributable_change: 建立并持续支持集贤院的校书、修撰与学术网络；组织开元跨区域测影、仪器制造和大衍历改革并颁行；完成《开元礼》等国家知识产品
records.field_coverage: textual compilation, ritual studies, astronomy, geodesy, calendrical science, and a broader high-Tang literary ecology; court concentration limits access claims
records.durability_and_handoff: the Dayan calendar, survey data, Jixian textual work, and ritual products survived beyond the immediate project window
records.cross_scene_replication: independent compilation, ritual-text, astronomical survey, instrument, and calendar-production scenes

counterevidence.summary: technical authorship remains with Yixing and other specialists; later political collapse does not erase products but caps general cultural attribution

records.era_relative_difficulty: high-Tang fiscal, printing-manuscript, and scholarly conditions permitted major court projects but did not automatically produce their technical and textual outputs

records.inherited_baseline: 武德已有突厥、契丹与奚往来和归附；不能把贞观前写成完全无接触。东突厥崩解后的大批降众安置及实际政治参与仍待解决。
records.attributable_change: 东突厥降众获保全部落、安置和首领入朝任职；契苾何力率千余家内属后安置甘凉并本人进入中枢，阿史那社尔率部归附后亦获任用；贞观二十二年契丹窟哥、奚可度所部内属后各授都督。这些是不同地域与关系结构中的已实现接纳，不是唐境内只有两个群体。
records.relative_change_level_basis: 主要北方群体由战后降附转入持续安置和政治参与，保P3；不能用群体名称数量累加R级。原N1没有闭合独立身份损害，改作反证压MID。
records.field_coverage: 东突厥降众、铁勒契苾部家庭以及契丹、奚内属部众；官职只证明首领参与，不代表所有普通人口获得相同身份。
records.durability_and_handoff: 639年改外徙、643年部众请求内居获准，应合看安置调整而非一概成果归零。648年契丹、奚新增安排在本人窗口较短；后继另有发展与反复，不能全部归本人，取MID。
records.cross_scene_replication: 降众安置、部落家庭内居、首领入朝与地方兼领；同一人的部落身份不得拆成新族群刷数量。

counterevidence.summary: 外徙反复、部分铁勒部众另择归属及后继冲突限制稳定性；现有材料不足以把抽象控制另定整数N1，亦不足R4或HIGH。

source_refs: 《旧唐书·卷一百九十四上》：全其部落、授首领官；贞观十三年外徙与十七年请内居。

《旧唐书·卷一百九十九下》：贞观二十二年窟哥、可度所部内属与松漠、饶乐授官。

records.inherited_baseline: Sui-Tang warfare had disrupted central educational supply and stable student pipelines
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: under manuscript-era transport and fiscal limits, sustained thousands in central instruction and new cross-group entry approached the feasible high range without implying mass education
records.background_trend: postwar recovery helped supply, but school expansion, fixed quotas, military education, examinations, and multi-group admissions required attributable action
records.attributable_change: 扩建学舍、固定官学生额并形成数千人受教与数千人听讲规模；军士教育、考试出路与多地域多群体首领子弟入学扩展制度可达性
records.field_coverage: several thousand central learners and listeners plus military, regional, and multi-group elite entry; still concentrated and quota-limited
records.durability_and_handoff: the network operated across the reign and provided a successor base; later expansion is not backfilled
records.cross_scene_replication: central cohorts, military education, examination exits, and multi-group admissions were independent access scenes

records.inherited_baseline: early Tang inherited fragmented dynastic records, disrupted scholarly organization, and no equivalent active state translation complex
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: manuscript-era state sponsorship could generate major projects, but multiple projects alone do not constitute a new knowledge-production paradigm
records.background_trend: scholarly recovery after unification is baseline; only commissioned and completed ruler-window projects are consumed
records.attributable_change: 贞观期完成梁、陈、齐、周、隋五史并启动《晋书》重修；李淳风奉命制浑天黄道仪并留下法象记录；玄奘归国后获得译场支持，形成实际译经协作。只计本人在位完成或运行的产出；《五经正义》653年颁行不回填。

records.durability_and_handoff: 五史和译经文本有后续使用；仪器不久失踪，《五经正义》全国颁行属高宗。多项目支撑R3，不足以把交班缺口写成HIGH。

records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: early Tang fiscal and manuscript constraints limited absolute scale, so several hundred central learners plus quantified local school quotas represent a meaningful recovery
records.background_trend: postwar normalization aided recovery; only Li Yuan's ruler-window school quotas, local reconstruction and education-to-examination routes are consumed
records.attributable_change: 武德初重建国子、太学、四门学并设置实际生员名额，同时重建郡县学校；武德七年进一步诏州、县、乡置学，使中央与地方重新形成可运行教育层级和人才推荐入口

records.inherited_baseline: Tang already had regular and special examination routes, but palace-level open recruitment and the same scale of ruler-driven special examination access were not yet routine
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: the mature early-Tang examination system could support wider recruitment, while family resources and elite educational preparation still constrained social reach
records.background_trend: the broader Tang shift toward examination-based advancement predated Wu; only her ruler-window expansion and realized recruitment mechanisms are consumed
records.attributable_change: 大规模开制举、搜访遗逸并亲临策试，形成面向更广士人的皇帝直接考试入口；相关考试实际授官和后续迁转，使考试成为新增的人才流动通道
records.field_coverage: large special-examination applicant pool and realized office-entry route, but still concentrated among literate male elites
records.durability_and_handoff: palace-level and special examination practices influenced later Tang recruitment, but the dynasty-wide long-run mobility trend is not credited wholesale to Wu

counterevidence.summary: exam-based mobility was an inherited Tang trend and access remained education-resource dependent; therefore the axis stays CIV2-LOW

records.inherited_baseline: 会昌灭佛刚刚造成全国寺院、僧尼、佛典和宗教活动空间的急剧收缩。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 新君可维持压制，也可部分恢复；完全回到会昌前规模受财政和制度约束。
records.background_trend: 社会佛教需求有恢复动力，但重新允许寺院、度僧和宗教活动属于宣宗政策。
records.attributable_change: 大中元年后明确纠正会昌末年过度灭佛，恢复京城及州府部分寺宇、僧尼身份和宗教活动，使被系统压缩的佛教知识、文本与组织空间重新开放。
records.field_coverage: 全国佛教寺院、僧尼和宗教知识传播空间，但并非全面恢复旧规模。
records.durability_and_handoff: 恢复后的佛教组织和知识传播延续至晚唐。

counterevidence.summary: 主要是修复单一宗教领域且伴随既有寺院经济问题，不进R3；但原R1明显过低。

records.inherited_baseline: 安史战争与长期分散保存使大量梵夹存在损坏、散失风险，译经材料分布在各寺院。
records.attributable_change: 乾元元年批准不空系统搜访长安、洛阳以及州县寺院、村坊所藏玄奘、义净、善无畏、菩提流志等遗留梵夹，集中大兴善寺修补、整理并陆续翻译，形成战乱后国家级梵文本保存—翻译基础设施。
records.field_coverage: 跨地域梵文佛典搜集、修补、集中保存与译经工作。
records.durability_and_handoff: 大兴善寺梵夹集中与译场机制延续代宗朝，形成稳定交班。

counterevidence.summary: 不空主要译经成果跨肃宗、代宗两朝，不能把后来110部143卷全部回填李亨；肃宗只消费758年实际建立并运转的搜访、集中和翻译机制，因此CIV2-LOW。

records.era_relative_difficulty: adjudicated against EARLY_WOODBLOCK_AND_MANUSCRIPT_TRANSITION; realized content or ecology change controls, not raw output counts, surviving copies, or later fame

records.inherited_baseline: 菩提流志武周时期虽已译多种经，但《大宝积经》完整编译工程尚未开始。
records.attributable_change: 神龙二年起菩提流志奉诏重新专译并编集《大宝积经》，在中宗窗口持续多年推进这一120卷大型佛典工程；完整成书到先天二年，故只消费中宗朝启动、组织和已完成的大量译卷，不回填后续完成态。
records.field_coverage: 大型佛典编译、梵汉文本整理和国家译场。
records.durability_and_handoff: 项目跨朝延续并最终完成，验证中宗窗口启动具有实际交班。

counterevidence.summary: 全经713年才完成，已越过中宗统治窗口；译学劳动属于菩提流志团队。因此只取CIV2-LOW。

records.field_coverage: 佛经重译、译场团队、寺院知识网络与跨区域密教传播。
records.durability_and_handoff: 不空译典和其弟子网络长期影响中晚唐及日本真言宗。
records.cross_scene_replication: 经文重译、译场协作、文殊阁及五台山传播网络等多个相关场景。

counterevidence.summary: 核心翻译和教义创造属于不空及译经团队，且是在肃宗既有译场上深化；多个R2场景只强化到CIV2-HIGH，不机械升R3。
